description: ACP agents: Claude Agent ACP, Codex ACP and opencode (needs Node: build from an image with Recipes/homebrew-node)

claude_acp.description: version of @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp (latest, or empty, for the newest)

codex_acp.description: version of @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp (latest, or empty, for the newest)

opencode.description: version of opencode-ai (latest, or empty, for the newest)

extras.description: more npm packages to install, separated by spaces (not expanded as file names), for example @google/gemini-cli @github/copilot; empty for none

checks: for command in claude-agent-acp codex-acp opencode; do command -v "$command" > /dev/null || { echo "$command is not on the path"; exit 1; }; done; echo "claude-agent-acp, codex-acp and opencode are installed"
home=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; CODEX_HOME="$home" codex-acp cli -V; status=$?; rm -rf "$home"; exit $status
